usage.outputShape: body.image_url (hosted JPG on DigitalOcean Spaces CDN); also body.image_description, body.metadata.replicate_url, body.metadata.aspectRatio, body.metadata.model
quirks: Payment accepted ONLY on Solana (USDC mint EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v) — there is no Base/EVM accept entry, so the paying wallet must hold Solana USDC.

Synchronous: a single paid POST returns the finished image URL immediately (no job/polling). Result is a CDN-hosted JPG at body.image_url; an alternate replicate.delivery .webp is at body.metadata.replicate_url.
Default aspect ratio is 1:1; the only required field observed is {prompt}.
usage.guide: Qwen Image is a synchronous x402-paid image generator from Xona, $0.05 per call, settled in USDC on Solana only (no EVM). Call POST https://api.xona-agent.com/image-model/qwen-image with a JSON body {"prompt":"..."}. The 200 response returns the finished image immediately at body.image_url (a CDN-hosted JPG); body.metadata.replicate_url has the original .webp. No polling or sign-in needed — just ensure the wallet holds Solana USDC.
